comment: sp_lev.c create_room() gives a fixed-position des.room() no gs.smeq entry, and mklev.c makecorridors() does not reset gs.smeq, so a level program's random_corridors() joins its rooms by the values the level below left. #wizloadlua minetn-7 over Dlvl 1 appends the town's room after the old rooms, whose entries the old makecorridors() already merged, so only consecutive rooms are joined. The seed is the second of 50100-50129 (minetn-7, this character and date) whose port replay changed when makecorridors() stopped resetting gs.smeq. Character, date and inputs chosen independently.
